title: Logan Lenz (5x exits) finishes the book — 'Anyone can vociferate their values. The incorruptible keep them'
summary: A founder with five exits reads the book as a sequel that takes on the harder question than the one Lean Startup answered: once you have built something good, how do you keep it good. His answer, and the line he closes on, is that shouting values costs nothing — companies go bad one small, easily justified exception at a time.
blockquote:
Most companies don’t go bad all at once. They go bad one small exception at a time, each one easy to justify.

Anyone can vociferate their values. The incorruptible keep them.
